description: This Java class 'DebugManagedDataSource' extends 'ManagedDataSource' to add debugging and connection pool information retrieval functionalities. It provides detailed logging when obtaining connections and exposes pool metrics via 'getInfo()'.

classes.name: DebugManagedDataSource
classes.description: A subclass of ManagedDataSource that adds debugging logs and provides connection pool metrics.

methods.name: DebugManagedDataSource
methods.description: Constructor initializing the data source with a connection pool and transaction registry.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Overrides to add verbose debugging logs when borrowing a connection from the pool.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns a map with current connection pool statistics and configuration details.
